seoSectionTitle: Edit PDF online — click any text and retype it
seoP1: Our Edit PDF tool lets you change the text inside any PDF without the original source file or design software. We detect every line of text on every page, so you can click straight into a name, number, date or sentence and retype it — all in your browser.
seoP2: Upload your PDF and click the text you want to change. The line opens pre-filled with its original text, keeping the same size, colour and style so your edit blends in. You can adjust the size and colour, and drop brand-new text anywhere on the page.

seoP3: Each line you edit is rewritten as real vector text on the original page, so the finished PDF stays sharp at any zoom, selectable, searchable and small. There is no watermark.

diveTitle: What actually happens when you edit
diveSubtitle: How text editing works under the hood, and what it can't do.
dive1Title: Editing existing text vs. adding new text
dive1Desc: Changing a word that's already on the page and adding a brand-new text box in empty space are different operations under the hood. Editing existing text tries to match the original font and size; adding new text lets you pick your own formatting freely.
dive2Title: Whiteout and retype — how it actually works
dive2Desc: To edit a line of existing PDF text, the tool covers the original text with a matching-color box, then places new, editable text in its place at the same position. This is why edited text stays sharp at any zoom, instead of becoming a blurry pasted-in image.
dive3Desc: A scanned page is just an image, so there's no underlying text to directly edit — you'd need to run OCR first to get an editable text layer, or use whiteout-and-retype to cover and replace specific areas visually, which works regardless of whether text is selectable.
dive4Desc: If the PDF's original font is a common one, edits match it closely. Uncommon or embedded custom fonts get substituted with the closest visual match, which can occasionally cause slightly different letter spacing — worth a quick zoom-in check on important documents.
dive5Desc: Images on the page can be selected, repositioned, and resized like any object — but the image's own resolution doesn't improve when you enlarge it, and quality degrades if enlarged significantly, the same as resizing any raster image.
dive6Desc: Complex vector graphics, charts built from multiple layered elements, and precise multi-column layouts can be trickier to edit cleanly than simple paragraph text. Pages you don't touch are left completely untouched, so editing one section never risks the rest of the document.
faq1Q: Can I edit the existing text?
faq1A: Yes. We read the text layer of your PDF and make each line directly clickable, pre-filled with the original wording so you only change what you need. The line you edit is replaced with real, selectable text in the finished file.
faq2Q: Will it match the original font exactly?
faq2A: We match the size, colour, weight and whether the text is serif, sans-serif or monospaced. Exact custom brand fonts aren't embedded, so a heavily styled font is replaced with its closest standard equivalent.
faq3Q: Will the rest of my document change?
faq3A: No. Only the lines you actually change are touched — the rest of the page, including images, layout and every other line of text, is left exactly as it was and stays fully selectable and searchable.
faq4Q: Is it safe to upload my PDF?
faq4A: Yes. Files are sent over an encrypted connection, scanned for malware, and automatically deleted from our servers within 1 hour.
faq5Q: Can I edit a password-protected PDF?
faq5A: Please unlock the PDF first using our Unlock PDF tool, then edit the unlocked file.
